newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile identifies diplomat found dead in Haiti.
newsitem.headline: Chile identifies diplomat found dead in Haiti.

text.p: Chile said on Monday that the charred of a Chilean diplomat was found in Haiti last week and there was evidence he may have been murdered.
An autopsy has identified the body as that of Eduardo Vega, 58, first secretary at the Chilean embassy in Haiti, said Fabio Vio, political director at the Foreign Relations Ministry.
"We have been told that it was Eduardo Vega and that the first signs are that it could be murder," Vio told reporters.
Vega's body was found last week in his burnt-out car by a Canadian patrol of the U.N. peacekeeping mission in Haiti.
Vio said the government expected to receive a copy of the autopsy, which should give more details of the circumstances surrounding Vega's death, on Tuesday.
"We have asked the Haitian government to carry out investigations into the case to know how the death occurred," he said.
